Meituan releases weights for LongCat-2.5, a 1.6T-parameter MoE model for long-horizon agentic tasks, under the MIT license, after unveiling it on November 1 (Carl Franzen/VentureBeat)
SoftBank reports Q2 net loss of $7B vs. a ~$15.8B profit a year ago, on ~$14B revenue vs. ~$12.8B est. as tech selloff weighs on results; shares close up 13.9% (Jenny Lee/CNBC)

item.title: GeniosAI, which develops AI software for financial analysis and modeling, raised $19.1M across seed and Series A rounds; FactSet led the Series A (Ryan Lawler/Axios)
Filings: Moonshot signed a deal in August to rent 32 China-based Super Micro servers with Nvidia B300, the most powerful AI chip, possibly in breach of US rules (Andy Lin/Bloomberg)
The White House picks Palantir CISO Michael LoSapio to lead the DHS' Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency, replacing Acting Director Nick Andersen (Reuters)
Australia is drafting legislation for an AI safety regulator empowered to impose "significant penalties" after an OpenAI model hacked a government site in Sept. (James Mayger/Bloomberg)
Analysis: Nvidia's 2025 figures to the US government undercounted chips sold to Megaspeed via partners by 50K; Nvidia did not give Bloomberg an exact figure (Mackenzie Hawkins/Bloomberg)
The US DOJ sues Lyft for allegedly discriminating against riders with disabilities, seeking $53M in compensation; Lyft disputes the allegations (Kanishka Singh/Reuters)
California voters reject Proposition 40, which would have imposed a one-time 5% tax on residents with a net worth above $1B to mostly help fund health care (Associated Press)
Trump Media Q3: $409.7M profit fueled by gains on digital assets, vs. a Q3 2025 $54.8M loss, and sales of $3M, $1.8M from subscriptions like Truth API, Truth+ (Elias Schisgall/Wall Street Journal)
